meta.name: District Seven
meta.description: Contested high-density block. Warehouse 7 is the real fighting position. Mosque courtyard EM is a decoy. Building 12 HUMINT is stale and cold on GEOINT. Market square is full of civilians.

events.payload: Informant places 6-8 armed personnel in Building 12, second floor. Heavy weapons mentioned. No names. Last seen four hours ago.
events.provenance: HUMINT SOURCE_09 / handler DET-41 / debrief log D7-441

events.payload: Thermal: two heat signatures in Warehouse 7 loading dock. Building 12 still cold — no thermal, no movement. Market square dense civilian heat.
RPK-pattern burst radio, two signatures, Warehouse 7 net, high duty cycle. Callsigns unknown.
events.provenance: SIGINT ELINT-17 / DF cut 3 / collection task CT-77

events.payload: Cellular ping cluster, 14 devices, Market square. Mixed civilian pattern. No tactical radio in this cut.
events.provenance: SIGINT CEL-PING-22 / passive IMSI catcher tasking P-22

events.payload: Local shopkeeper reports men moving from Building 12 toward Warehouse 7 twenty minutes ago. Unconfirmed. No weapons seen by the shopkeeper.
events.provenance: HUMINT PATROL-3 / walk-in / field notes FN-19

events.payload: Strong VHF at Mosque courtyard. No corresponding UAV motion. Signature matches known decoy repeater profile. Confidence is in the RF match, not in occupancy.
events.provenance: SIGINT DRONE-EM-08 / UAV-EM payload / library hit DECOY-RPTR-3

events.payload: Mosque courtyard: no personnel, parked van, possible antenna. No thermal of an armed group. Courtyard otherwise empty.
Same source now claims QRF will be hit at the Overpass if they approach Warehouse 7. Ambush language. Source was not on the ground for this claim.
events.provenance: HUMINT SOURCE_09 / handler DET-41 / second debrief D7-442

events.payload: Second RPK signature, same net, Warehouse 7 roof. Heavy weapons presence on the net.
events.provenance: SIGINT ELINT-17 / DF cut 4 / collection task CT-77

events.payload: Change detection: sandbags on Warehouse 7 roof since last pass 90 minutes ago. Civilian foot traffic at Market square unchanged.
events.provenance: GEOINT CHG-DET-01 / stereo pair T-90 / T-0

events.payload: Unidentified hash burst. No demod. Likely noise.
New heat bloom Warehouse 7 roof, 3-4 bodies. Building 12 still cold. Market square civilian heat unchanged.
